shortDescription: Manage SyncIQ target cluster certificate on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: certificate_id
options.description: ID assigned by the system to certificate. This parameter does not affect server behavior, but is included to accommodate legacy client requirements.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the certificate. Map users to a specific user and/or group ID after a failed auth attempt.

options.name: new_alias_name
options.description: Alias name for the certificate in case of modify operation.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to mention the existence of SyncIQ certificate.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
